=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. He is only obtainable through the Raid Shop and Rumbling Stars. He can be bought for 50 Path Shards and you need 2 of him to evolve [[Usurper]] into [[Usurper (Founder)]].
He is also the boss of stage 3 of [[Story#Shiganshinu District|Shiganshinu District]] as The Beast Titan.
